connector.name: Energyai
connector.registryDescription: Free clean-energy tools: incentives, solar estimates, scores, guides, quotes, local installers.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.energyaisolution.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.energyaisolution, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: OPTIONAL. Eight public tools need no key. Every free result links to production-key activation. A new key includes three commercial trials; bootstrap_energy_project creates persisted context in one call. Builder is $19/month with $20 monthly tool credit.
